summary: CareBridge V2 end-to-end testing complete. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_carebridge_v2.py covers all V2 features: 403 self-registration, search/patients (mask + min_length + phone-digits), dashboard/activity, dashboard/active-draft, followups/upcoming, autosave (persistence + 404), duration, followup (with timeline log), patient timeline (reverse-chronological), family-accounts (create, list, add member, member-phone inheritance, consultations scoping, consent required), auto-generate (Claude — single call), backward compat (legacy summary endpoints + simple patient create), privacy (list masks vs detail unmasked) — 26/26 PASSED. Frontend Playwright covered: Login V2 (no Create Account, Contact admin info present), all 6 stat cards + Recent Activity widget + Patient App Coming Soon, Start Consultation dialog opens & search returns Rahul Kumar, navigates to /consultation/{cid}, big 00:00:00 timer renders, save-transcript-btn present, Quick-Add patient flow creates patient + consultation, Patient Profile family + timeline tabs present, Create Family makes patient 'Self' and exposes Add Family Member, Timeline shows events (Consultation Started, AI Summary Generated, Follow-up Scheduled), SummaryReview followup-date-input renders, Approve button present, share-patient-btn correctly hidden until approval. ALL V2 ACCEPTANCE CHECKS GREEN.

minor.issue: Body field is named 'role' implicitly via hardcoding 'doctor' — admin cannot create a non-doctor user. Acceptable for V2 scope but document the constraint.
On generation failure resets summary_status to 'not_generated' but does NOT log a 'summary_generation_failed' activity event — recovery from failure is opaque to the audit log.

Treats any consultation with vitals={} OR visit_reason!='' as 'active'. A consultation that was created with just a visit_reason (the default flow) is immediately surfaced as a draft to resume. Consider also gating on transcript or recording_started_at to avoid noisy banners.

issues: Email/password fields still pre-filled with demo credentials in production-looking UI — flagged in iteration_1, still present.

action_items: No blocking bugs. Optionally tighten /api/dashboard/active-draft heuristic so an empty consultation with only visit_reason set does not surface as a draft.
Optionally log 'summary_generation_failed' activity event when /auto-generate exceptions, for audit completeness.
Carry-over from iteration_1: tighten CORS_ORIGINS (set explicit URL instead of '*') since allow_credentials=True is in use.
Carry-over: remove demo credential prefill from Login.jsx before any production deployment.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1231 lines — past the 700-line soft threshold. Split into routers/{auth,patients,consultations,family,dashboard,search}.py and services/{ai,storage,activity}.py.

auto_generate_both runs two sequential Claude calls in a foreground request (~10-20s). Consider background task + polling endpoint so the UI does not hold an open HTTP connection that long (and survives client disconnect).
Patient/family scoping is correct (doctor_id filter everywhere checked), and family member phone inheritance is enforced server-side — privacy + multi-tenant scope are solid.
AutosaveUpdate model accepts vitals: Optional[dict] without schema — a malformed dict could pollute consultation.vitals. Consider a sub-model with explicit fields (bp, hr, temp, spo2).
FollowUpUpdate.followup_date is Optional[str] with no ISO validation — Pydantic Field(pattern=...) or date type would prevent garbage strings.
set_followup logs 'followup_scheduled' but does not log a corresponding 'followup_cleared' when followup_date is set to None — audit trail asymmetric.

derive_consultation_status is referenced but its definition wasn't seen in the slice viewed — confirm it returns one of the 6 documented labels (draft/pending_summary/generating/pending_review/approved/shared).
family-accounts: no endpoint to DELETE a family member or unlink a patient from a family — irreversible by API. Consider adding for completeness.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the V2 surfaces tested (login V2, dashboard, dialog, quick-add, profile tabs, family creation, timeline, summary review)

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created: TEST_FamPrimary User (+919811112222), TEST_Spouse User (family member), TEST_LegacyV2 Simple (+919811119911), TEST_NoConsent (400-tested only, not created), plus several TEST_v2-prefixed consultations on Rahul Kumar. Frontend Playwright created: 1 PT-* TEST_<unique>... patient via Quick-Add + its consultation, and 1 TEST_FamUI NewPrimary patient with a family account (FAM-*). All safely prunable by E1 — none collide with seeded sample patients.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both pytest suites are stable regression: /app/backend/tests/test_carebridge_api.py (V1, 19 tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_carebridge_v2.py (V2, 26 tests). The V2 file makes exactly ONE /auto-generate Claude call (1-2 Emergent credits). For UI re-tests, use page.evaluate('fetch...') to call API with credentials:'include' — urllib outside the browser context cannot carry httpOnly cookies through the preview ingress. The Patient App nav item is intentionally non-clickable. Family member creation requires consent_given=true (returns 400 otherwise). SummaryReview share-patient-btn only renders after the consultation is approved.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. All 14 V2 acceptance criteria from the review_request validated as working. Minor non-blocking observations logged in backend_issues.minor + critical_code_review_comments.
